profile.summary: East Bay Innovations is a nonprofit based in San Leandro, California, that supports people with disabilities. Its services include supported living, independent living, employment services, community day supports and assistive technology. It also runs a supported employment program with the YMCA of the East Bay that prepares participants for careers in early childhood education.
